QuestInfo.name: Cleaning Up The Streets - Continued
QuestInfo.0: There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
QuestInfo.1: I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out #b200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons#k in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
QuestInfo.2: I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons have fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...

0.0: Hey! If it isn't my favorite deputy. Ready for some hunting?

yes.0: That's the attitude that got me where I am today! Ok, let's do this again! I'm going to corral this town into a crime-free zone. I know how the devious monster mind works, having trained as a thief for many years. So, you're going to have to wipe out #b200#k of two types-I believe #bElectrophants and Gryphons#k should prove a suitable test of your skills! Take your time and report back when you're done!

1.0: OUTSTANDING! I knew you were special the second I looked at you.

yes.0: Here's your reward, as promised. I'm proud of you! You can come and see me anytime you wish perform your duty as a citizen of New Leaf City!

mob.0: Come on, you're not done yet, but I have faith. You can do it!
